_comment: Published reference values for scripts/validate-pk.ts. Every entry cites the sentence it came from. Rows may carry Cmax or tmax alone — the gate applies per metric and flags what is missing. 'no published reference' is an honest outcome, not a gap to fill.

references.cmax_note: observed mean ± SD 6255.10 ng/mL; treatment E (FDC oral, 1000 mg acetaminophen + 300 mg ibuprofen); converted ÷1000 to mg/L
references.source_title: Pharmacokinetics and Bioavailability of a Fixed-Dose Combination of Ibuprofen and Paracetamol after Intravenous and Oral Administration (Clin Drug Investig 2015;35:625-632)

citation_pack.publisher_values: Population-model predicted (fasted tablet, 1000 mg): Cmax 12.8 mg/L (95% PI 6.76-24.2), tmax 0.61 h (0.26-1.24)

references.tmax_note: DailyMed label — Combogesic (setid f863558f-2a44-41f8-a6b7-271851d4c2ff): 'peak plasma concentration following the administration of three COMBOGESIC tablets occurs at approximately 45 minutes and 1 hour 15 minutes after administration for acetaminophen and ibuprofen, respectively, under fasting condition.' Reviewed OpenCode source review, 2026-11-13.

references.cmax_note: observed mean ± SD 5178.29 ng/mL; treatment E (FDC oral, same combination product); converted ÷1000 to mg/L
references.source_title: Pharmacokinetics and Bioavailability of a Fixed-Dose Combination of Ibuprofen and Paracetamol after Intravenous and Oral Administration (Clin Drug Investig 2015;35:625-632)

citation_pack.publisher_values: Population-model predicted (fasted tablet, 300 mg): Cmax 24.1 mg/L (95% PI 13.3-40.8), tmax 0.94 h (0.48-1.67)

references.tmax_note: DailyMed label — ibuprofen suspension (setid dda7645f-1666-4c1f-b974-01add2ea79ac): table legend 'T max (h) 0.79 (69%) 0.97 (57%)'. The cited excerpt does not label the columns; 0.79 accepted as recorded in data/pk-parameters.csv by OpenCode source review, 2026-11-13 — which column the value belongs to is not legible from the excerpt. Kept with this caveat: do not read 0.79 as a fasted-tablet reference.

references.note: Arancibia 1980 (PMC283758) reports serum level SCHEDULES and rate constants (alpha 3.40/h, kappa a 1.02/h, ka absorption half-life 0.72 h) but no Cmax or tmax in the same source; no freely accessible published Cmax located. Do not fill from memory.

Tran 2017 (PMID 29018999) reports NLME parameters (ka 0.860/h, apparent CL/F 11.1 L/h, apparent V/F 81 L) but prints no observed or predicted Cmax or tmax in the abstract; not located in the accessible full text. Do not fill from memory. Label sweep (9d6def7) recorded t_max_h 0.75/0.79 for acetaminophen/ibuprofen; gabapentin tmax still not published in its source — unchanged.
Banwo 2024 (PMC11593559) and the DailyMed caffeine citrate label carry ka, F, CL and V but no published Cmax or tmax for a defined oral dose. Do not fill from memory.
